usageNotes: Use this to inspect the top-level firewall configuration for a specific LXC container, including whether the firewall is enabled, default input/output policies, and which protocol helpers (DHCP, NDP, MAC filter, IP filter) are active. Requires VM.Audit on the container's path — no write privilege needed. Note that this returns container-level options only; individual firewall rules are fetched via the separate rules endpoint.

examples.summary: Retrieve firewall options for LXC container 110 on node pve01

tips: If 'enable' is false (the default), all firewall rules for the container are bypassed regardless of what rules exist.
ipfilter=true is the recommended security baseline for containers — it auto-populates interface ipsets with MAC-derived IPv6 link-local restrictions and the container's configured IP addresses.
macfilter defaults to true (enabled), providing an extra layer against ARP spoofing; verify it is not unexpectedly disabled on untrusted networks.
log_level_in and log_level_out default to 'nolog' — set to 'info' or 'debug' temporarily when troubleshooting dropped traffic.
